quotes.text:
task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    description: Generates flatpak by repackaging the existing .tar.xz
    run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
    run-on-releases: [beta, release, esr153]
    shipping-phase: promote
    scopes: []

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    description: Generates snap by repackaging the existing .tar.xz
    run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
    run-on-releases: []
    shipping-phase: promote
    scopes: []
Flatpak repackaging (//not// pushing) and Snap repackaging are now included. -Daniel

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The monthly-release landing enables several packaging and verification tasks and explicitly leaves Flatpak pushing outside its scope. At the fixed endpoint, Flatpak repackage runs for beta, release and esr153 and has shipping-phase: promote; Snap repackage now has run-on-releases: []. Do not carry the historical Snap-enabled claim forward or infer that producing an artifact publishes it. Upstream task transforms and actual release execution were not tested. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Separate release packaging enablement from shipping enablement
